summary: InMode Ltd., an Israeli medical device company, filed a Form 6-K disclosing that SP Strategic Holdings LLC, an affiliate of Steel Partners Holdings L.P., filed an urgent application in Haifa District Court seeking to enjoin the company's special committee from evaluating a going-private proposal from M.N. Business Strategy Ltd. The application questions director independence, and the court has postponed the decision until at least July 19, 2026, pending a hearing. The filing signals an ongoing strategic review process with litigation risk. Watch for the court ruling and whether the special committee proceeds—any deal would likely be subject to Israeli court oversight and possible competing bids.
